name: Scenario
tagline: Train custom models to generate style-consistent game assets.
description: Scenario lets game developers train custom models on their own art references (5-100 images) to generate style-consistent assets across image, video, 3D, and audio. It offers a node-based workflow editor, 550+ underlying models, and an API plus MCP server for agent integration. It is used in production by studios including Ubisoft, Unity, and Scopely.
insight: Raised a $6M seed (Jan 2023) led by Play Ventures; angels include Oculus's Brendan Iribe and Hugging Face's Clement Delangue.
edge: Custom-trained per-studio style models keep generated assets on-brand — beyond generic text-to-image tools.
cons: Credit-based cost adds up at scale

references.title: Scenario rolls out generative AI tool targeted at game devs
